explanation.summaryZh: 短文综述梦的科学：梦与学习记忆、情绪调节有关，也包含大脑对日常信息的重组。

sharedOptions.text: Dreaming, in other words, may be the brain's way of cooling down the day.
Why would a healthy brain waste so much energy on a show we can hardly remember?
They reflect real work that keeps our memory and mood in shape.
During deep sleep, the students' brains quietly practised the same movements again.
Eating cheese late at night is widely believed to cause vivid dreams.
The sleeping mind grabs pieces of ordinary life and rebuilds them into something new.
Modern machines can record dreams perfectly.

segments.text: Every night, whether you remember it or not, your brain tells stories. Most dreams fade within minutes of waking, yet they return night after night.

Recent studies now offer some clues.

One strong idea links dreams to learning. In an experiment, students who learned a new computer game in the morning improved faster that week if they had dreamed about it.

It seems the sleeping brain replays new skills, the way a coach reviews yesterday's match.

Dreams also work with feelings. Volunteers who watched an emotional film before bed showed calmer reactions to it the next morning, and their brain scans revealed why: during dreams, the emotion centres lit up again and again, each time with less intensity.

Night after night, this gentle repetition seems to take the sting out of painful memories.

Not every dream carries a deep message, though. Many are strange mixtures of recent events, put together in silly combinations.

A student who spent the day packing for a trip might dream of a school building made of suitcases. To some researchers, such dreams are simply the brain sorting through the day's leftovers.

Whatever dreams are finally shown to be, they are not useless accidents.
So the next time you wake with a strange story in your head, treat it with respect: it may be a small report on how your brain cared for you overnight.

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句用实验说明做梦的学生进步更快，o4 描述睡眠中大脑重复练习，与后句大脑回放新技能一致。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句写情绪中枢反复激活但强度递减，o1 用换句话说总结梦为一天降温，后句进一步说明。

gaps.explanationZh: 后句以行李箱拼成教学楼的梦为例，o6 抓住日常生活碎片重组正引出该例子。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.explanationZh: 前句说梦不是无用的意外，后句以所以提出尊重梦，o3 说明梦反映记忆与情绪的真实工作。
